text:
jess: Quick heads-up — we need a cross-team design review for the multi-model routing work. This covers API shape, SDK helpers, and Console routing UX. I uploaded a short pre-read + checklist (Notion) and a draft PR. Can folks volunteer reviewers and mark availability?

jess: Links: https://notion.redwood/team/multi-model-routing-pre-read  PR: https://git.redwood/infer/multi-model-routing/pull/42

sam: thanks — marking interest. timezone: PST. I can do Tue/Wed morning (PST). 30m should be fine if we stick to the checklist. :thumbsup:

kai: I can review API and SDK bits. prefer Wed 16:00-18:00 UTC. 45m if we want to demo the console flow.

maria: I can cover Console UX and run the demo. Wed works for me too. We should confirm personas and failure cases in pre-read.

oliver: pinging infra folks — @eng-sre will need to sign off on the fallback routing plan. I can join as optional.

jess: proposed slots (UTC):
- Tue 15:00-15:30 UTC (30m)
- Wed 16:00-16:45 UTC (45m)
- Thu 09:00-09:30 UTC (30m)
Please react with :one: :two: :three: or reply with other times.

sam: :two: looks best for me.

kai: :two: for me but +15 for demo.

maria: :two: and will prepare a 5-min demo recording in the pre-read (if needed).

jess: ok reserving Wed 16:00-16:45 UTC for now. Maria, do the demo recording and drop link in the pre-read by EOD Monday.

maria: will do. rough checklist I'm adding to the Notion pre-read now:
```
- Context + goals (1 slide)
- API surface changes (diff + example requests)
- SDK helpers (usage + migration notes)
- Console mockups & flows (happy / degraded)
- Backwards compatibility risks
- Rollout plan + fallback policies
- Required approvers (SRE, security, product)
```

sam: small ask — add a short perf note (expected latency delta and test harness). even a rough number helps prioritization.

jess: good call. Kai, can you add a perf stub?

kai: sure, I'll run the usual 1k reqs/day sim and paste results.

oliver: one operational item — we need a canary policy for dedicated capacity. I've added a bullet under rollout.

design-bot: Reminder: submit the pre-read at least 24h before the meeting to allow reviewers time.

jess: final question — do we want to invite product PM (lee) and compliance (taylor)? Lee should be invited; compliance only if we surface data-routing concerns.

sam: +1 invite Lee.

kai: will DM Taylor if we think routing touches PII.

maria: agenda draft for Wed:
- 5m quick context (Jess)
- 10m API + SDK walkthrough (Kai + Sam)
- 10m Console demo (Maria)
- 10m rollout & ops (Oliver)
- 10m Q&A / decisions (all)

jess: perfect. Maria to drop demo link and I'll update the calendar invite with the Notion pre-read attached.

maria: demo link: https://videos.redwood/demo/multi-model-routing.mp4 (uploading final version now)

sam: can someone add the PR link and checklist to the calendar invite so product can pre-approve?

jess: done. calendar invite sent to participants + lee. I set meeting as "required" for reviewers (Kai, Maria, Sam, Oliver).

oliver: if anyone can't make it, please add brief notes to the pre-read and label "unable-to-attend" so we can capture async approvals.

kai: small doc quirk — SDK examples include a new config flag `prefer_local_model`. Will note migration steps.

jess: thanks everyone — see you Wed 16:00 UTC. If anything changes, reply here or update the Notion page.

sam: noted.

maria: :rocket:

jess: (closing) pre-read link again: https://notion.redwood/team/multi-model-routing-pre-read — please add comments inline.
